whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Banjara Boring Road,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 3.9★ ratings across 720+ reviews in Sri Krishna Puri, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/banjara

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Banjara Boring Road team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly menu, direct WhatsApp food ordering, and your Sri Krishna Puri location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
